headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 28, 2026**
article:
The Texas Rangers secured a 7-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Kumar Rocker earning the win after 6.2 innings of work. Joc Pederson led the Mariners' offense with 2 home runs and 4 RBIs.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Kerry Carpenter being placed on the 10-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers due to left foot plantar fasciitis. Other notable injuries include Spencer Steer's right wrist sprain with the Cincinnati Reds, Cody Bellinger's left hamstring strain with the New York Yankees, and Josh Jung's left calf strain with the Texas Rangers.

The Pittsburgh Pirates made a notable trade, acquiring right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. Rodríguez joins the Pirates' roster.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Mariners 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 7-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Kumar Rocker earning the win after 6.2 innings of work. Joc Pederson led the Mariners' offense with 2 home runs and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Tigers 8-5**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Coby Mayo leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Rico Garcia earned the save and also recorded 2 strikeouts in a scoreless inning of relief.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Diamondbacks in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Arizona Diamondbacks 3-2 in a closely contested game. Max Kepler led the Diamondbacks' offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Walk Off in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 8-7 in a closely contested game. Heriberto Hernández led the Marlins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Kerry Carpenter Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right fielder Kerry Carpenter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left foot plantar fasciitis.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. Rodríguez joins the Pirates' roster.
